title: audit_verification
description: The answer of GET /api/v1/audit/verify: the audit log's hash chain recomputed on the server (OpenSpec audit-hash-chain).

ok.description: true when every event after the checkpoint follows from the one before

uncovered.description: kept events from before the chain started, not covered

checkpoint.description: where checking starts: the last pruned event (or the newest from before the chain) and the hash the next event chains from

head.description: the newest checked event, the anchor to keep outside the server

break.description: the first event whose hash does not follow, or null
